name: Cafe Lalit (HPTDC)
why_it_matters: HPTDC's day-tripper canteen housed inside Chini Bungalow — the colonial-era cottage where Indira Gandhi and Zulfikar Ali Bhutto stayed during the 1972 Shimla Agreement negotiations. The only proper sit-down restaurant on the Kufri main strip; #1 of 9 on TripAdvisor mostly because the alternatives are food-cart maggi.
insider_tip: Eat in the open courtyard, not the indoor section — the courtyard view and ice cream are why most reviewers come. Skip the Chinese; stick to the thali and biryani which the kitchen actually cooks well.
signature_address: Chini Bungalow, Kufri-Chail Road, Kufri, Shimla District, Himachal Pradesh 171012

name: ABC Sher-e-Punjab
why_it_matters: Sit-down Punjabi joint at Chharabra, halfway between Kufri and Wildflower Hall — the patio looks straight onto the deodar valley. Ranked #3 of 9 in Kufri on TripAdvisor (3.7/5, 15 reviews); reviewers single out the biryani and the view, not the menu range.
insider_tip: Phone +91 96259 93533 ahead on weekends — patio fills with day-trippers from Wildflower Hall and the hotel itself doesn't allow non-resident dining. Cards accepted; cash backup recommended for a quick exit.
signature_address: Charabra, near Wildflower Hall, Kufri, Shimla District, Himachal Pradesh 171012

name: Bawa Cafe & Snacks Bar
area: Near Indira Gandhi Tourist Park (Kufri Nature Park)
why_it_matters: Single-shopfront cafe on the path to Kufri Nature Park / Indira Gandhi Tourist Park — fresh maggi, ₹130 for a thali plus two teas. The honest day-tripper option that locals point tourists to instead of the overpriced food carts at the ski resort entrance.
insider_tip: Open daylight hours only; closes by sunset (~6pm winter, 7pm summer). Carry small change — UPI works but slow on the patchy 4G. The thali is the value pick over maggi if you're properly hungry.
signature_address: Near Indira Gandhi Tourist Park, Kufri, Shimla District, Himachal Pradesh 171012
